options: total distance divided by total time
distance moved in a specified direction

answer.explanation: A. Velocity is the rate of change of displacement.

distractor_explanations: Option 1 correctly defines velocity: rate of change of displacement.
Option 2 defines average speed, not velocity.
Option 4 omits direction and incorrectly uses speed instead of displacement.
hints: Velocity is linked to a vector measure of change in position.
The required phrase uses rate of change and displacement.
solution: A. Velocity is the rate of change of displacement.
teacher_walkthrough: Velocity must include the directional information carried by displacement.
B is the formula for average speed. C defines displacement, not velocity. D omits the possibility that direction changes.
Therefore the exact controlled definition in A is correct.
